student_learning_goal: I can compare a prediction to actual data and refine my model.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can compare a prediction to actual data and refine my model.
header.character_watermark: Coach Cara in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Compare 5 predict-vs-actual scenarios. Find each gap.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. Five comparison rows.

image_placeholders.description: Five comparison rows in B&W, ~7in x 3.5in. Columns: 'Predict | Actual | Gap'. Pre-filled: (200, 185, ___), (1250, 1180, ___), (320, 350, ___), (180, 195, ___), (2800, 2800, ___). Header 'Predict vs Actual:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P1_COMPARE: keywords (predict, actual) name the rows.

parts.student_instructions: Refine 3 rules based on actual data.
parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. Three refining boxes.

image_placeholders.description: Three refining boxes in B&W, ~7in x 2.5in. Each: 'Old rule: ___' and 'Refined rule: ___'. Pre-filled rules. Header 'Refine the Rule:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P2_REFINE: keywords (refine, rule) name the boxes.

parts.student_instructions: Reflect on a real community prediction. How would you refine?

image_placeholders.description: A reflection area in B&W, ~7in x 2.5in. 'I predicted: ___'. 'Actual: ___'. 'Refine to: ___'. Header 'My Real-Life Refinement:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P3_MY: keywords (my, refinement) name the box.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, refine TWO rules for the same situation.
teacher_notes: Lesson 4 worksheet. Watch for over-refinement trap.
